rationale: Anthony brings deep expertise in applying ML to cyber-physical infrastructure and IoT systems—areas where Ambarish is actively deploying vision language models and sensor fusion on real hardware. Anthony's conviction that graph neural networks and relational approaches outperform LLMs for structured enterprise data, combined with his production experience at PG&E, could directly inform Ambarish's work in autonomous navigation and real-time robotic deployment, while Ambarish's hands-on robotics and hardware-software integration experience offers practical grounding for Anthony's interest in sustainable infrastructure applications.
intro_message: Anthony James, meet Ambarish G K — you both work at the intersection of ML and real-world cyber-physical systems, and Anthony's production data science background in energy infrastructure could complement Ambarish's robotics and sensor fusion work.
